> 6 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Articles — Risk And Security under Card Brand Monitoring Programs. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Card Brand Monitoring Programs

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/overview): Chargebacks and fraud are an unfortunate reality of doing business and you can expect to receive both in some regard, especially if you are an ecommerce business.
- [Visa Acquirer Monitoring Program (VAMP)](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/visa-programs/visa-dispute-monitoring-program): Effective April 1, 2025, the Visa Dispute and Fraud Monitoring Programs were consolidated into the Visa Acquirer Monitoring Program (VAMP).
- [Visa Fraud Monitoring Programs](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/visa-programs/visa-fraud-monitoring-programs): Visa has identified an account's threshold to be flagged in the Visa Secure Excessive Fraud Program.
- [Excessive Chargeback Program](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/mastercard-programs/excessive-chargeback-program): Mastercard has a global chargeback monitoring program called the Excessive Chargeback Program (ECP) that monitors chargebacks, defines non-compliance thresholds, identifies when…
- [Excessive Fraud Merchant Program](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/mastercard-programs/excessive-fraud-merchant-program): Mastercard has a global fraud monitoring program called the Excessive Fraud Merchant Program (EFM) that monitors your account for fraud, defines non-compliance thresholds,…
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/risk-and-security/card-brand-monitoring-programs/frequently-asked-questions): We know that managing chargebacks and fraud can be intimidating. Here are a few common questions about Visa and Mastercard's monitoring programs:
